issues.title: 1.1.7 loaded after Viewpoint 0.1.7: the game closes while it loads the mods
issues.note: With Viewpoint 0.1.7 (2026-11-15) loaded first, the game class zombie.SandboxOptions is already loaded when this addon's Java patches it (getWaterShutModifier, doesPowerGridExist), so ZombieBuddy (2.3.4) re-patches it and starts it before Lua exists: NullPointerException ('thread is null'), ExceptionInInitializerError, then 'GameThread exited'. It worked on 42.22.2 with Viewpoint 0.1.6 (2026-11-12). Loaded before Viewpoint, the game started and loaded a save once (2026-11-16); Viewpoint then switched itself off in that session, but because of Viewpoint - Light Fix, which fails at start with Viewpoint 0.1.7 whatever this addon does. Exhaustive Power Rework itself does not need this addon: switching it off is the sure fix; loading it before Viewpoint was seen to work once.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen three times in console.txt on 42.22.2 with ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 when loaded after Viewpoint; one session loaded before it started (2026-11-16)

issues.title: Every key press writes an error to the log
issues.note: Its key handler asks the game for a key binding with no name (the "[FancyHandwork]" header of its own list), and the game logs a NullPointerException each time: hundreds a session. The mod works the same. Nothing to do: with the Studio's Live Bridge on, the errors are no longer written.
issues.log: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "zombie.input.KeybindId.getId()" because "keybindID" is null at zombie.core.Core.getKey(Core.java:3023)
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen in the game log on 42.21 until 2026-11-02; 2.5.1 still has the same code

issues.title: Hidden indicators block clicks at the top-left of the screen
issues.note: When it hides an indicator it moves it far off the screen, but the game puts it back at the top-left corner, invisible, over the equipped-item icons: right-clicking the primary hand does nothing. The Studio's shim patch modern_status fixes it.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio: 22 indicators at 0,0 in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30); 2.5.5 still moves them to -20000 and 42.22's ISUIElement:setX still keeps them on the screen (code read 2026-11-17)

issues.title: Attacking with something that is not a gun writes an error
issues.note: While an attack is under way it looks for a tank to shoot even when the hand holds no firearm, and asks that item for a gun's range: "Object tried to call nil in findAimTarget". The Studio's shim patch propane_explosion fixes it.
issues.log: ERROR: General f:188498> Lua((MOD:Propane Explosion)).findAimTarget> Exception thrown java.lang.RuntimeException: Object tried to call nil in findAimTarget
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, reproduced in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30, the log said line 632); the installed 1.1.0 still makes the same call, now at line 982 (read 2026-11-17)

issues.title: Its check for walls around a room fails on Build 42.22
issues.note: It asks a tile for its wall flags with get(IsoFlagType...), which 42.22 does not take (the game's own code uses has): "No implementation found for function: get(...PropertyContainer..., IsoFlagType WallN)". That check stops with an error each time; the rest of the mod goes on. Nothing to fix from here: its author has to change those calls (12 of them).
issues.log: ERROR: General      f:3> Lua((MOD:Realistic Temperature)).edgeHasBlockingOnSquare> Exception thrown
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, game log on 42.22.2 (8 sessions, 2026-11-16 and 17); the 2.4.0 copy updated 2026-11-17 14:56 still has the call at line 439

issues.title: Two of its Java changes do not fit Build 42.22
issues.note: ZombieBuddy cannot apply its changes to a weapon's knockdown (HandWeapon.getKnockdownMod) and to a zombie being hit (IsoZombie.Hit): the game's methods use other number types than the mod expects. Body weight does not change those two parts of combat; the mod's other changes load. Nothing to do until its author updates it.
issues.log: LOG  : General      f:0> [ZB] [!] ERROR transforming zombie.inventory.types.HandWeapon: Cannot assign double to float.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, game log: in 16 of 16 sessions on 42.22.2 with the copy installed 2026-11-12 (no modversion)

issues.title: 0.1.7: ZombieBuddy left it out until its author re-uploaded it unsigned (2026-11-16), and its addons took the game or server down
issues.note: The first 0.1.7 jar (Workshop update of 2026-11-15) was signed with a key its author's Steam profile does not show, so ZombieBuddy left Viewpoint out ('invalid ZBS') and addons built on it failed at boot with NoClassDefFoundError viewpoint/...; one exposed to Lua stopped the game or the server. On 2026-11-16 the author re-uploaded 0.1.7 without a signature: after Steam updates it, it loads. A copy the Studio made in Zomboid/mods before that still carries the old Viewpoint.jar.zbs: Mod Health offers to copy it again. If ZombieBuddy still leaves it out with 'blocked by policy=prompt', a "don't allow" for that jar was saved during the broken hours: hold Shift while the game loads and allow it in ZombieBuddy's window (the Studio never edits that file).
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen in a server's server-console.txt on 42.22 (2026-11-16)

issues.title: 0.1.7: crashes while preparing or building the scene with old addons carried along
issues.note: Players report Viewpoint 0.1.7 crashing ('Crashed while: preparing' or 'building the scene'). The advice shared by its players: switch off the old addons it carries along, in Viewpoint's own settings, the lines addons.legacyCarried.legacy_... set to 1 (legacy_dry_cure, legacy_fletcherarcheryfixes, legacy_pzvoxelstudioviewpoint, legacy_viewpointfences3d, legacy_viewpointlivingprops, legacy_viewpointvisibleloot): set them to 0. A 'Failed to compile shader: version 130 is not supported' line is the graphics driver, not the mod list.
issues.source: Reported by players of the mod, 2026-11-16

issues.title: Switches itself off on Build 42.22
issues.note: 1.4.6 says a game method it needs is missing and turns itself off at every start; the game uses its own gun combat instead. Nothing breaks, it just does nothing. Nothing to do until its author updates it; switch it off if you prefer a shorter list.
issues.log: LOG  : General      f:0> [TrueBallistics] ERROR True Ballistics disabled: a required game method is missing (game update?). Vanilla firearm combat is used.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, game log: off in 18 of 18 sessions on 42.22.2, on in 127 of 127 on 42.21 (same 1.4.6)
